appearances.title: alibaba/open-code-review
appearances.summary: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

appearances.title: alibaba/open-code-review

appearances.why: The built-in ruleset covers issues such as NPE, thread-safety, XSS and SQL injection, and it works with OpenAI and Anthropic APIs.
